source.note: The original narration is locked by projects/easel-enhanced-golden/evidence/evidence-lock.json and is not modified by this document. This document is a spoken derivative for the voice track only; captions and the original script keep their own text.

rules: Long sentences are split so a single sentence carries less information.
Facts, numbers, product names and conclusions are preserved; nothing is added.
Segments are labelled by semantic role: INTRO, PROBLEM, EVIDENCE, TURN, CONCLUSION.
Pauses are placed at sentence and clause boundaries, using the provider-documented <#x#> marker (x in seconds, 0.01-99.99).
A pause is never placed at the edge of a segment text and never two in a row.
No rhetorical question or transition was added that the original did not already contain; the opening question in paragraph 1 is already a question, and it receives its pause at the colon.
authoring.cannot_be_proved_mechanically: Tone, naturalness and sentence-level semantic equivalence. The mechanical checks cover the evidence lock, digit tokens, protected phrases, pause syntax and role coverage; a Founder listening/reading pass remains the acceptance gate.
authoring.operator_note: Paragraphs 1-3 in the original are written close to spoken register already; paragraphs 4-6 are where written-style clauses are longest and were split the most. Editorial normalisation applied: lowercase 'easel' in paragraph 4 -> 'Easel' so the pronunciation lexicon rule applies; 'Web 工作台' kept verbatim.

protected_phrases: 真能被调起来的生产引擎

sample.note: The A/B/C experiment sample: the opening three paragraphs, approximately 20-30 seconds at the measured pace of the existing Golden narration. A reuses a local excerpt of the existing Golden audio; B and C are new subscription-plan synthesis.

segments.text: 装了 Easel 之后，最先要回答的是：<#0.3#>它到底跑不跑得起来。
我把它锁在 v0.2.1。<#0.3#>982 个文件，逐个比对过哈希，和上游 tag 完全一致。
它不是一个 SaaS，而是一层 Skill 库。<#0.4#>114 个 Skill，分成发现、策划、创作、发布、归因五层，<#0.3#>创作层最大，52 个。
doctor 跑起来了，Python、Node、FFmpeg，这些核心项都是绿的。<#0.3#>ping 里，Agent 的真实往返也通了。
但有个坑：<#0.3#>网关健康检查，探的是写死的默认端口，和 Easel 实际网关端口对不上，<#0.3#>那一行是红的。
Web 工作台这条路，有六项没过。<#0.4#>fastapi、uvicorn 这些依赖没装，前端也没构建，.env 里也没有 API Key。<#0.3#>所以，Web 界面现在还没验证。
结论：<#0.4#>它不是开箱即用的产品，<#0.3#>但是一个真能被调起来的生产引擎。<#0.4#>CLI 和 Skill 这条线，今天是通的。
